unit: 七上·Units 3–4 My School / My Favourite Subject
subject: english
title: 小升初衔接 · 英语 Units 3–4
source: 七年级上册 Unit 3 My School、Unit 4 My Favourite Subject：学校设施、方位介词、there be、学科与课程表、why/because、时间介词。按初一单元测试题型编写（不含听力），百分制

items.stem: There ______ a library and two science labs in our new school.
items.exp: 就近原则：离 be 最近的是 a library，用 is。表示“某地有某物”用 there be，不用 has/have。

items.stem:
—Excuse me, where's the art room?
—It's ______ the music room, on the second floor.
items.exp: next to 在……旁边。between 要说 between A and B，这里只有一个地点。

items.stem:
—______ is your favourite subject?
—Science. I like doing experiments.
items.exp: 问最喜欢的科目是什么，用 what。

items.stem:
—______ do you like maths?
—Because it's interesting and useful.
items.exp: 答语用 because 说原因，用 why 提问。

items.stem: We have PE ______ Tuesday and Thursday.
items.exp: 在星期几用 on。

items.stem:
—Who is your music teacher?
—______
items.exp: 问“是谁”，回答人名。B 描述外貌，回答的是 What is he like?

items.stem: History is ______ subject, but some students think it's ______.
items.exp: interesting 以元音音素开头，用 an；be 后接形容词 difficult。subject 是可数名词单数，前面要有冠词。

items.stem:
—When is your English class?
—It's ______ 8:00 ______ Monday morning.
items.exp: 具体时刻用 at；具体某一天的早上（Monday morning）用 on。坑点：in the morning 是泛指，前面有 Monday 就要用 on。

items.stem: My little sister likes ______ very much. She draws pictures every day.
items.exp: 每天画画，喜欢美术 art。

items.stem:
—Do you have a computer lesson today?
—No, we ______. It's on Friday.
items.exp: Do you...? 用 do/don't 回答，主语 we，用 don't。

items.stem: Our school is big and beautiful. There are many tall trees ______ the playground.
items.exp: 树长在操场四周，用 around。

items.stem: Monday is the ______ day of the school week in China.
items.exp: 表示顺序用序数词，the first day 第一天。

items.stem: I like Chinese very much, ______ I don't like maths.
items.exp: 喜欢语文，“但是”不喜欢数学，前后转折，用 but。

items.stem:
—Thank you for showing me around your school.
—______
items.exp: 别人感谢你的帮助，回答 My pleasure（不客气，我很乐意）。It doesn't matter 是回答道歉的。

items.stem:
—How do you like your new school?
—______
options: It's great! The teachers are very friendly.
items.exp: How do you like...? 问“觉得……怎么样”，要回答看法。

sections.title: My New School
sections.passage:
My name is David. I'm a new student (16) No. 5 Middle School. Let me tell you about my school.
There are (17) buildings in our school: a classroom building, a library building and a science building. The classroom building is (18) the playground, so we can go out to play quickly after class. In the library, there are many (19). I often read there after class.
Our school day starts at 8:00. We have four classes in the morning and (20) in the afternoon. That's seven classes a day.
My (21) subject is science. It's interesting because I can do many experiments in the lab. I don't like history (22) I think it's difficult. Our science teacher is Ms. Lee. She is very (23) to us, and she always helps us.
On Friday afternoon, we have a club day. I'm in the (24) club because I like singing.
I love my new school, and I'm (25) every day.

items.exp: 在某所学校用 at：a student at No. 5 Middle School。
冒号后列出了教学楼、图书馆楼、科学楼，共三栋。
下课能很快出去玩，说明教学楼在操场旁边。
后一句说常去那里读书，图书馆里有很多书。
后一句说一天共七节课，上午四节，下午就是三节。
后面说科学很有趣，是最喜欢的科目：my favourite subject。
不喜欢历史的原因是觉得难，用 because。
后面说她总是帮助我们，对我们很好：be nice to sb.。
因为喜欢唱歌，参加的是音乐社团。
喜欢新学校，每天都很开心。

groups.label: A
groups.title: Class 1, Grade 7 Timetable
groups.passage:
Class Time
Morning: 1st 8:00–8:45 / 2nd 8:55–9:40 / 3rd 10:00–10:45 / 4th 10:55–11:40
Afternoon: 5th 2:00–2:45 / 6th 2:55–3:40
Monday: Chinese, Maths, English, History | PE, Art

items.stem: What is the first class on Monday?
items.exp: Monday 一行第一个是 Chinese。

items.stem: When is the music class?
items.exp: 竖线后面是下午的课，Music 在 Tuesday 的竖线后面，是周二下午。

items.stem: How many maths classes do they have from Monday to Wednesday?
items.exp: 周一、周二、周三各有一节数学，共三节。

items.stem: How long is each class?
What time does the Geography class start on Tuesday?
items.exp: Geography 是周二下午第二节，即第 6 节，2:55 开始。

groups.label: B
groups.title: Our Favourite Subjects
groups.passage:
Li Mei: My favourite subject is geography. I like to learn about different countries and places. My dream is to travel around the world one day.
Bob: I like PE best. It's relaxing, and I can play basketball with my friends. But I don't like maths because it's too difficult for me.
Zhou Kai: Science is my favourite. The experiments are really fun. Our science teacher, Mr. Wu, always says to us, "Ask why. Don't be afraid of making mistakes."
Emma: I love music. I can play the violin. I have music lessons on Tuesday and Friday, and I practise for half an hour every evening.

items.stem: Why does Li Mei like geography?
options: Because she likes to learn about different places.
items.exp: I like to learn about different countries and places。

items.stem: What does Bob think of maths?
items.exp: it's too difficult for me。relaxing 是他对体育的评价。

items.stem: Who likes doing experiments?
items.exp: Zhou Kai 说 The experiments are really fun。

items.stem: How many music lessons does Emma have a week?
items.exp: on Tuesday and Friday，一周两次。每晚练琴半小时是她自己练习，不是上课。

items.stem: What does Mr. Wu want his students to do?
options: Ask questions and not be afraid of mistakes.
items.exp: Ask why. Don't be afraid of making mistakes.

sections.title: My Favourite Day
sections.passage:
Hi, I'm Mike. My favourite day is Friday. (36) W______? Because we have PE and art on Friday. They're my favourite (37) (subject).
At 8:00 we have maths. It isn't easy, (38) ______ our maths teacher, Mr. Smith, makes it interesting. Then we have English. I like English because it's (39) (use). After that, we have PE (40) ______ 10:00. We play basketball and run.
After lunch, we have art. I like (41) (draw) pictures. Our art teacher is Ms. Wang. She is (42) (real) nice. Our school (43) (finish) at 3:40 on Friday. After school, I play games with (44) (I) friends. On the weekend, I don't have any (45) (class). I'm very happy!

items.exp: 后面用 Because 回答，所以这里问 Why。
They're 后接复数 subjects。
数学不简单，“但是”老师讲得很有趣，前后转折，用 but。
be 后接形容词，use 的形容词是 useful。
具体时刻前用 at。
like doing sth. 或 like to do sth. 都可以。
修饰形容词 nice 用副词 really。
主语 Our school 是第三人称单数，finish 以 sh 结尾，加 -es。
名词 friends 前用形容词性物主代词 my。
any 用在否定句中，后接可数名词复数；class 以 s 结尾，加 -es。

sections.prompt:
你校英语报正在征集“My School Life”主题短文。请根据以下提示写一篇短文：1. 简单介绍你的学校（至少两处地方及其位置）；2. 你最喜欢的科目及原因；3. 你最喜欢星期几，为什么。要求：60 词左右，开头已给出，不计入总词数；文中不得出现真实姓名和校名。
My School Life
points: 介绍学校的两处地方及位置
写出最喜欢的科目和原因
写出最喜欢的一天及原因
语言正确（there be、方位介词、because、时间介词），书写规范
sections.sample:
My School Life
My school is big and beautiful. There is a big playground in front of the classroom building. The library is next to the dining hall. I often read books there after class.
My favourite subject is English because it's interesting and useful. I can talk with people from other countries in English.
My favourite day is Wednesday. Why? Because we have English and music on Wednesday. I love my school life!
sections.exp: 要点写全后检查：there is/are 用就近原则；位置用 next to、in front of、behind、across from；说原因用 because；星期几前用 on。
